critique: The render retains the correct black ground, warm deep-orange circular bokeh palette, soft sprite edges, and gentle coherent evolution from t1 to t4. It is still substantially more sparse and orderly than a rich preset bokeh field: broad black gaps dominate both samples, while most visible discs occupy a similarly large size range. The high opacity randomization leaves several particles nearly black and makes the overall orange read muted brown rather than a more consistently luminous deep orange. Sprite-center texture marks are still evident on the largest discs.

suggestions.why: Increase the particle grid horizontally to fill the large empty black regions with a denser bokeh field.
Increase vertical particle density along with the horizontal grid so both frames remain richly populated rather than leaving broad gaps.
Slightly reduce the maximum disc diameter so the increased particle count creates layered bokeh variation instead of being dominated by uniformly oversized circles.
Reduce opacity randomness so fewer particles fall to near-black and the orange field reads brighter and more consistently luminous.
